prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (RDC; call sign Juniper) provides 24/7 EMS intake, triage support, ambulance dispatch, mutual aid/regional coordination/shared picture under approved protocols; jurisdictions retain resources/local policy. RDC records caller reports, authorizations, unit rationale, alternate routes/destinations, facility responses, unresolved constraints/restrictions; maintains coverage from unit location/status/readiness excluding Fleet Maintenance Cell (FMC; Bluejay)-restricted vehicles and separating accepted mutual-aid assignments in Ambulance Coordination Platform (ACP), which queues updates through brief interruptions and flags reconciliation. CAD Console shows incident/priority/travel/unit/constraints/staging/surge/latest confirmed status and is scenario-tested before regional release. Call Taker Mara (Larkspur) validates location, captures clinical/access/callback, stays connected when feasible, produces Caller Location Correction Slip, confirms incident/facility before destination request, receives Bedside Arrival Receipt and verifies arrival. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield) assigns priority/basis, handles uncertainty/conflict/deterioration/disputes, sends Pediatric Acuity Note, approves temporary override, identifies immediate-radio calls, and reviews risk cases involving acuity/escalation timing. Pediatric concerning ABC/mental status needs prompt escalation. Regional Medical Director reviews findings/significant events, sets/approves clinical guidance within authority. Shift Commander (Sundial) approves overcapacity/exceptions/nonstandard/reduced coverage, reviews coverage/access, receives Coverage Gap Bulletin, assigns surge coordination, sends Mutual Aid Release Form, may restrict capabilities for unresolved unacceptable-risk defects, decides staffing/deployment/escalations, retains authority until successor. Radio Coordinator (Mistral) manages Regional Radio Network talkgroups/acks/retries/diversions/fallback, change cards, and uses South Access Lane Notice in operational review; network/interfaces checked after maintenance/configuration before normal use. If voice fails use approved data channel/timestamps; reconcile after restoration. Hospital Liaison Desk confirms acceptance by telephone during disruptions and contributes protected observations. Ambulance Unit 417 acknowledges, reports arrival/handover/restored-contact status; crews report conflicts/status/staging/pediatric changes. FMC uses Mutual Aid Release Form, schedules preventive work by manufacturer/service/regional requirements; records asset/work/parts/return-to-service. ACP monitored for availability/response/data integrity/interfaces. Audits identify records/criteria/limitations; evidence retained under controls. Findings get owner/due date/closure verification; corrective actions track demonstrated effectiveness; recurring issues get systemic review. Releases assess operational/clinical/security/continuity

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
